summary.text: Alaina Shonkwiler is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 29, has served since 2024, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Alaina Shonkwiler graduated from Noblesville High School in 2001 and earned a bachelor's degree in public affairs management from Indiana University Bloomington.

Her career experience includes roles as a business development associate at Garmong Construction, a manager in government consulting at Katz, Sapper & Miller, and the district director for U.S. Rep. Victoria Spartz.
Shonkwiler assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Chuck Goodrich, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
She is the only candidate listed for District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Government and Regulatory Reform, House Public Policy, and Utilities, Energy and Telecommunications committees.
